description: RejoinLab (P031) — AG-UI event-stream rejoin and conversation-state consistency lab. Local-first, offline, CPU-only.
name: rejoinlab

scripts.test: npx vitest run && python3 -m pytest -q oracle/tests && python3 -m oracle.run_goldens && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:determinism: vitest run tests/core/determinism && esbuild scripts/verify_determinism.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/.verify-tmp/verify_determinism.mjs --log-level=error && node scripts/.verify-tmp/verify_determinism.mjs
scripts.test:offline: npm run build && esbuild scripts/verify_offline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/.verify-tmp/verify_offline.mjs --external:playwright --log-level=error && node scripts/.verify-tmp/verify_offline.mjs
scripts.test:oracle: python3 -m oracle.run_goldens && npx vitest run tests/replay/golden.test.ts
scripts.test:performance: vitest run tests/s0/performance.test.ts && npm run build && esbuild scripts/verify_performance.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/.verify-tmp/verify_performance.mjs --external:playwright --log-level=error && node scripts/.verify-tmp/verify_performance.mjs
scripts.test:privacy: npm run build && esbuild scripts/verify_privacy.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/.verify-tmp/verify_privacy.mjs --external:playwright --log-level=error && node scripts/.verify-tmp/verify_privacy.mjs
